standard-dialogue-before-plague-city.npc: Hello, I don't recognise you. We don't get many newcomers around here.

standard-dialogue-after-plague-city.npc: I'm surprised you're still here. Not many like to stick around this place if they have the choice.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-rid-of-t.npc: Not bad, the city is still a mess but we've finally got the chance to change that now the mourners have gone.

standard-dialogue-after-getting-rid-of-t.player: Good to hear, all the best.

treasure-trails-medium.npc: Let's see if you have what it takes to answer this question.

treasure-trails-medium.text: Jethick has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-medium-when-talked-to-ag.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.text: Jethick has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
